activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed in work clothes
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Packing work bag, checking phone for shift messages, final grooming
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient rounds, assessments and clinical care
Taking a short lunch break at the hospital
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, charting and handover preparation
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating at home
Showering and washing up with hot water
Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
Relaxing: watching TV and browsing on the computer while using the fan instead of the air conditioner during the evening peak
Quiet wind-down: using phone and desk lamp, preparing clothes for tomorrow
